gloss: to act violently; to rage; to run wild

definitions.gloss: to act violently; to behave wildly
definitions.explanation: To behave in an uncontrolled, violent, or destructive manner.
When natural forces or animals become violent and uncontrollable.

examples.japanese: {酔|よ}っ{払|ぱら}いが{店|みせ}の{中|なか}で{暴|あば}れている。
examples.english: A drunk is acting violently inside the store.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{九州|きゅうしゅう}で{暴|あば}れた。
{子供|こども}たちは{公園|こうえん}で{暴|あば}れ{回|まわ}っていた。
examples.english: The children were running wild around the park.

notes:
{暴|あば}れる is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). There is no direct transitive pair.

ASPECT ({ている}):
{暴|あば}れている indicates an ongoing state of violent or wild behavior.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {暴|あば}れ{回|まわ}る - to run wild, to rampage
- {暴|あば}れ{出|だ}す - to start acting violently
- {暴|あば}れん{坊|ぼう} - a wild child, troublemaker

RELATED WORDS:
- {暴力|ぼうりょく} - violence
- {乱暴|らんぼう} - violent, rough (na-adjective)
- {荒|あ}れる - to become rough/stormy (related but different nuance)
